Lakurawa: a hybrid group  
Lakurawa is hard to pin down. Most analysts say it first emerged in Sokoto State around 2016–2017, drawn mainly from Malian and Nigerien individuals, though its exact parent groups are contested. The Institute for Security Studies traces it to a merger of former Macina Liberation Front fighters, now part of JNIM, and a Nigerien faction rooted in defending herders. [...]
